Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

Why CoolSculpting is gaining popularity in Osaka and how the treatment works

The reason behind CoolSculpting gaining popularity in Osaka isLess downtime and less strain on the bodypoints are involved.

Unlike aesthetic fat cooling services, CoolSculptingApproval from the Ministry of Health, Labor and WelfareAs it is a medical device that has received medical attention, it can only be used in clinics where doctors are on staff.

Differences in treatment mechanisms, characteristics, and equipment models
  • Mechanism of medical slimming that promotes apoptosis by cooling and freezing fat cells
  • Features of the treatment, which has almost no downtime and is easy to attend even for busy people
  • Differences between CoolSculpting ELITE and the old model

CoolSculpting is a treatment that can reduce the burden on the body because it does not involve scalpels or injections.

In OsakaUmeda/Shinsaibashi/Namba areaThere are multiple introduction clinics concentrated in the area, making it a convenient location where you can go after work or on weekends.

In this section, we will summarize the basics of CoolSculpting from three points: the treatment mechanism, characteristics, and differences in equipment models.

Mechanism of medical slimming that promotes apoptosis by cooling and freezing fat cells

CoolSculpting reduces fat cells by approximately4〜5℃Cells die naturally by cooling toapoptosisThis is a medical slimming procedure that causes

Apoptosis is a phenomenon in which cells die according to their own program, and the major difference from surgical fat removal is that only specific cells can be removed without damaging surrounding tissues.

Fat cells killed by cooling will be removed after the treatment.1-3 monthsIt is excreted from the body.

For this reason, it is difficult to see visible changes immediately after the treatment, and it takes a certain period of time to feel the effects.

Fat cells that die due to apoptosis do not regenerate, sodifficult to reboundThere is a characteristic that.

Why the effects of CoolSculpting last
  • Cooling (approximately 4-5℃) → Apoptosis (natural death) of fat cells
  • Dead fat cells are excreted from the body via lymphatic vessels over a period of 1 to 3 months.
  • Once apoptotic fat cells do not regenerate, they are difficult to rebound.
  • However, as the remaining cells enlarge, your body shape changes, so you need to maintain your lifestyle habits.

However, the number of fat cells is reduced by the treatment, and if the remaining fat cells enlarge, the body shape will change.

If you do not change your diet and exercise habits after the treatment, the remaining fat cells may enlarge and cancel out the effects.

After properly understanding the mechanism of the treatment, consult your doctor about the number of cycles that is appropriate for your target body type.

Features of the treatment, which has almost no downtime and is easy to attend even for busy people

CoolSculpting does not require any restrictions on daily life after the treatment, which is a major reason why it is chosen by busy working adults.

Non-invasive procedure that does not use a scalpelTherefore, in most cases, you can take a bath, exercise, and return to work on the day of the treatment.

During the treatment, a suction device called an applicator is applied to the skin to cool it.

Treatment time per area35-75 minutesIn some cases, it is possible to treat multiple areas on the same day.

Procedure on the day of treatment and general reactions
  • Treatment time: Approximately 35-75 minutes per area
  • There are clinics that can treat multiple areas on the same day.
  • Immediately after treatment: Redness and temporary numbness may occur.
  • Symptoms usually subside on their own within a few days.
  • In many cases, it is possible to take a bath, exercise, and return to work on the same day.

Immediately after the treatment, there may be some redness or temporary numbness in the cooled area.

In most cases, these symptoms subside spontaneously within a few days, and are thought to cause little long-term disruption to daily life.

rarelyParadoxical fat hyperplasiaThere may be side effects called. If you notice changes such as fat becoming hard or increasing in volume after the treatment, please consult the clinic where you received the treatment as soon as possible.

During your pre-surgery consultation, tell your doctor about your constitution and lifestyle so that he or she can put together a treatment plan that suits you.

Differences between CoolSculpting ELITE approved by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare and the old model

cool sculpting ELITEThis model is designed to shorten treatment time and expand the range of areas that can be treated compared to the previous model.

The previous model's applicator applied to each area one at a time, but ELITE allows you to use two applicators at the same time.dual sculptingcan be done as standard.

This allows symmetrical areas to be cooled at the same time, significantly shortening the total treatment time.

In addition, ELITE's applicator has a wider contact area than before, expanding the area that can be covered with one cooling.

The old model is also a medical device approved by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare, and the basic mechanism remains almost the same.

However, the models in place vary by clinic, so we recommend confirming which device to use during your consultation.

Clinics that have introduced ELITE may be able to reduce the total number of hospital visits by treating multiple areas on the same day.

Before undergoing treatment, please check the type of equipment and the area to be treated, and choose a clinic that suits your goals.

The equipment used for fat cooling in medical clinics and aesthetic salons is different.

CoolSculpting and fat cooling services provided at beauty salons may look similar, butEquipment usedThe approval status is fundamentally different.

Correctly understanding this difference is the first decision you should keep in mind when choosing a treatment destination.

Fat cooling in medical clinics and aesthetic salons—3 differences
  • Differences between medical clinics that use officially approved equipment and aesthetic salons that use non-official equipment
  • By receiving treatment at a clinic where a doctor is employed, you will be better able to deal with side effects.
  • Why people who are not satisfied with fat cooling at aesthetic salons go to medical institutions

The treatment category of fat cooling has spread to beauty salons in recent years, but there is a difference between officially approved equipment used in medical institutions and equipment used in beauty salons.Cooling output, accuracy, and response system for side effectsare completely different.

Although both are sometimes explained using the phrase "chilling to reduce fat," please consider that the services actually provided are different.

Differences between medical clinics that use officially approved equipment and aesthetic salons that use non-official equipment

Cool sculpting isMinistry of Health, Labor and WelfareThis is a medical device that has been approved under the Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Act.

Approved devices have clinical data regarding their effectiveness that have passed review, and treatments are performed under specified output and temperature controls.

On the other hand, many fat cooling devices used in beauty salons have not been approved under the Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Act.non-medical equipmentIt is.

Unapproved devices have not been reviewed as medical devices, so there are no public standards for cooling accuracy or output consistency.

It is important to note that fat freezing at beauty salons is not a medical procedure, so even if a problem occurs, you will not be able to receive treatment from a doctor.

The reason CoolSculpting can only be used in medical clinics is becausePharmaceutical device lawThis is because the handling of approved medical devices is limited to those with medical licenses, according to regulations.

If your beauty salon offers a treatment using the name "Cool Sculpting,"Are you using genuine equipment?Please confirm this at the time of counseling.

By receiving treatment at a clinic where a doctor is employed, you will be better able to deal with side effects.

The biggest benefit of receiving CoolSculpting at a medical clinic is thatA system is in place for doctors to be involved.It's a point.

It is not uncommon to experience some redness or temporary numbness after the procedure, which often subsides within a few days.

But rarelyParadoxical fat hyperplasiaThere may be side effects called.

Paradoxical fat hyperplasia is a condition in which the fat in the area that has been cooled grows and hardens, and although it occurs less frequently, surgical treatment may be necessary.

Paradoxical fat hyperplasia is often noticed 1 to 2 months after the procedure, so if you notice any changes, please promptly consult the clinic where you underwent the procedure.

Clinics with doctors on staff can provide a series of medical responses when such side effects occur, including examination, treatment, and referral to other departments.

What is paradoxical adipose hyperplasia?

A side effect is that the fat in the area that has been cooled grows and hardens. Although the incidence is low, there are cases in which it does not disappear spontaneously, and surgical treatment may be necessary. This is often noticed 1 to 2 months after the treatment, and if you notice any changes, please consult the treatment clinic immediately.

Beauty salons do not allow medical practice, so even if a problem occurs, the practitioners cannot provide medical treatment.

Not only the result of the treatment, but alsoSystem for responding to unexpected risksIncluding these factors is an important criterion when choosing a clinic.

Why people who are not satisfied with fat cooling at aesthetic salons go to medical institutions

There are a certain number of people who have tried fat freezing at a beauty salon, but are unable to see the changes they expected and end up going to a medical clinic.

In the background,Equipment output differenceThere is a difference in treatment accuracy.

Approved as a medical device, CoolSculpting is clinically designed to provide the necessary temperature and pressure to efficiently cool and destroy fat cells.

Non-approved equipment may not be able to reproduce the same cooling effect, and even after repeated treatments,Hard to lead to changes in body shapeIt may happen.

Main reasons for moving from aesthetic salon to medical clinic
  • Non-approved devices may not be able to reproduce the same cooling effect as medical devices.
  • Risk of continuing to pay for course fees without seeing results
  • At medical clinics, doctors explain the applicable areas, number of cycles, and expected effects, so it is less likely that expectations will deviate.

In addition, treatments at beauty salons are generally sold in courses based on a number of sessions, and there is a risk of continuing to pay for multiple sessions without seeing results.

At the medical clinic, the doctor during counselingApplicable site/number of cyclesThis makes it easier to avoid discrepancies between the purpose of the treatment and the actual results.

If you are not able to get satisfactory results from the beauty treatment, first consult a medical clinic to confirm your current fat condition and the appropriate treatment plan.
